Strategy: Best Fit scoring plus a bonus when the leftover is an exact multiple of the current item size, so residuals that divide evenly into item-sized slots outrank slightly tighter ones. The ranking differs from Best Fit only when the tightest leftover is not a multiple of the item. It may help by aligning residuals with repeatable item sizes, or fail because exact multiples are rare for varied item sizes.

```python
def priority(item, bins):
    return [(-(r - item) + (50 if (r - item) % item == 0 else 0)) for r in bins]
```
